sources.name: Video Games Chronicle
sources.title: Rockstar has revealed the official launch trailer for Grand Theft Auto 6
sources.text: The 90-second trailer features original music from Justice Rockstar has released the official launch trailer for Grand Theft Auto 6. The 90-second trailer details the game’s plot, and introduces newcomers to the protagonists Jason and Lucia. “Vice City, USA,” the trailer’s official description reads. “Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. “But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida â forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive.” The new trailer features original music from French electronic music duo Justice. The pair have composed the game’s original score, Rockstar says. It has also confirmed that a new Justice single,Â Flower in a Hurricane feat. Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, will be available on Grand Theft Auto 6 : The Album, the game’s official soundtrack. Rockstar states that the trailer was captured entirely on a PlayStation 5 , but doesn’t specify whether this is the base console or a PlayStation 5 Pro. Grand Theft Auto 6 will be released on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S on November 19, and will be the studioâs first major new single-player release since Red Dead Redemption 2 , which arrived on PS4 and Xbox One in 2018. In a recent interview with Bloomberg , studio heads Phil Hooker and Aaron Garbut said there won’t be another eight-year gap between GTA 6 and Rockstar’s next game after that. According to the pair, the technology created for this game, as well as the team that was formed to work on it, will carry over to the next project, which should reduce development time. âThe engine, the tools and the team weâve built during this project will allow us to do things more quickly,â Hooker said. âI feel confident that we can build on top of this and go more sideways than upwards to build more compelling content.â Garbut added: âWe foundationally changed a lot of stuff on this project. But now itâs done, and weâre not going to rip it apart.â

sources.name: Kotaku
sources.title: Surprise, Here’s A New Grand Theft Auto 6 Trailer
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 fans have been begging Rockstar for another look at the upcoming open-world sequel for months now, and their wishes have been granted as the game just got a big, new launch trailer as we enter the final weeks before GTA 6’s release on November 19. On October 15, Rockstar Games dropped GTA 6 ‘s launch trailer online without any teasing. This trailer will likely play on TV and in theaters around the country as Rockstar ramps up its marketing push for what will be one of the biggest games in history. Here’s the trailer: In the new minute-and-a-half trailer, we learn more about why Jason has seemingly turned to a life of crime. He explains, “I got in trouble in the army. Didn’t leave on the best of terms. They don’t give loans or anything to people like me.” So it appears that he feels forced into this life and might be looking for a way out. Elsewhere in the trailer, we see a lot of action, as you’d expect, with guns being fired, crime being committed, and cars being driven.Â But there’s also something I didn’t expect to see in aÂ GTA trailer: sex in the shower. This trailer makes it very clear that Jason and Lucia are a couple that will share intimate moments with each other, and if you were curious if the couple’s sex life would be shown directly on screen, it appears that, at least once, such a moment will indeed be depicted in the game . How far we’ve come since the Hot Coffee days. The new trailer also features a fresh song from electronic duo Justice, who also composed the original score for GTA 6. The new track is “Flower in a Hurricane” and features Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard and the Lizard Wizard. Rockstar has confirmed that the song will be included in the game’s official soundtrack release. The long wait for Grand Theft Auto 6 is nearly over. After years and years of rumors, delays, leaks, and more leaks, GTA 6 is coming out soon. The game will finally arrive next month on November 19 on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X, and Xbox Series S. sources.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 launch trailer suddenly drops, showing a saucy shower scene, a tense police chase, and high-flying heists
sources.text: Rockstar Games has released the launch trailer for Grand Theft Auto 6 ahead of its 19th November release. The trailer showcases the thrills set to come to the game on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S next month, with the footage itself apparently captured on the PlayStation 5. It features a selection of tidbits Grand Theft Auto fans may be interested in, including clips of heists in-action, one of which appearing to include a helicopter getaway gone awry. There's also an intimate shower scene between the game's two protagonists, seemingly confirming the rumoured sex scenes and likely full nudity . There's a quick cut between a collection of other characters we'll run into, and various setpieces. Eagle-eyed viewers may spot some interesting details, including what appears to be an ankle tag on Lucia's leg, hinting she perhaps is out on parole. Jason also seems to get a reverse-charged phone call early on in the trailer, suggesting perhaps Lucia calling from jail. The trailer opens with a shot of The Keys, a much-discussed portion of the GTA 6 that has been largely unexplored in prior trailers and gameplay footage. Also, the song playing in the background is a new standalone single from Justice called "Flower in a Hurricane", featuring Tame Impala, SZA, and the fantastic King Gizzard and the Lizard Wizard. The timing of the trailer is questionable, with Rockstar's employment tribunal ongoing in Glasgow , Scotland this week, and after a week of new leaked gameplay videos from the hacker Cyberleek. As what is likely the final trailer for Grand Theft Auto 6 before it releases, it's certainly a good tone setter for those eager to hop in.

sources.title: The Grand Theft Auto 6 launch trailer is here
sources.text: This one's got a very different vibe than what we've seen previously. We won't get to play Grand Theft Auto 6 when it launches for consoles on November 19, but they can't stop us from watching the Grand Theft Auto 6 launch trailer! So, let's do that. It's definitely a trailer for a GTA game, but this one feels a bit more restrained to me than what we've seen in the past—or maybe more focused is a better way to put it, with a greater emphasis on character and narrative than the chaos of the previous games, or even the previous GTA 6 trailers. There's definitely a cinematic flair to it—makes me feel like I'm settling in for the season-ending two-parter of a Michael Mann series from a decade or so ago. So what's cooking in our newest trip to Leonida? "Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive." The musical choice is interesting: Rather than the licensed music of the first two trailers (Tom Petty's Love is a Long Road in trailer one , The Pointer Sisters doing Hot Together in trailer two ), this tune is a new track from Justice, an electronic duo who composed the GTA 6 score. If you dig it, here's the full version—it's pretty good! We still don't have a release date, or even an official announcement, for the PC version of GTA 6, although there's no doubt one is coming—it always happens, sooner or later. A recently floated rumor said it'll be out sometime in early 2027, just a few months after the console debut, but I'm not buying it . sources.title: The Sex Scene Is One Of The Best Parts Of Grand Theft Auto 6′s New Trailer
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 is just a little over a month away and Rockstar is cranking up the marketing campaign,Â with a new surprise launch trailer this morning . Much of the new footage shows co-leads Jason and Lucia doing crimes in Vice City, but in between all the violence and debauchery, we got our first glimpse of an actual sex scene between the couple, and what we saw looks actually like a lovely, tender moment between the two in a shower. We only get three shots of the scene, but Rockstar has taken care to paint it in a certain way. The only real lighting is what looks like a sunset outside the bathroom window, as if the two are either getting up for an early start, or maybe have been up all night have been riding a wave of drinks, multiple sessions, and other recreational activities. It’s not frisky or high energy at first, but the second shot we see shows the two really starting to get into it. Then the third shot does get a little bit cheekier, as it shows Lucia’s house arrest ankle monitor, though even that can be a bit somber in the right context. As much as she’s enjoying being with her man, there’s a reminder that even though she’s out of her cell and living life again, she’s not entirely free. These are only a few shots of what is likely a longer scene, and it’s unclear just how explicit it will get since it’s been confirmed through leaks thatÂ Grand Theft Auto 6Â will include player character nudity , but what we can see does seem like a depiction of sex that’s more intimate than it has typically been in the series. Perhaps the most famous sex scene in all ofÂ Grand Theft AutoÂ wasÂ San Andreas ‘ “Hot Coffee” mod that included a playable sex mini-game based on cut content from the game. But that wasn’t meant to be in the final game, and in general, a lot of sex in Grand Theft Auto is implied but not shown, like when you pick up sex workers in your car in GTA 3 , or is played for humorous juxtaposition, like Trevor’s raunchy introduction in Grand Theft Auto V . I’ve already really enjoyed the loving dynamic between Jason and Lucia in the trailers , and I’m glad to see that their relationship continues to stand out as something made of real intimacy when Grand Theft Auto ‘s portrayal of sex could easily be another example of its most excessive tendencies (and there will be plenty of that , no doubt). Grand Theft Auto 6Â is coming to PS5 and Xbox Series X/S on November 19, and there are reports that a PC version may not be too far off . Donât miss the latest reviews, news and tips. sources.title: GTA 6 Launch Trailer Teases Jason's Troubled Past, a Steamy Shower Scene With Lucia, and Much More
sources.text: Rockstar has released the launch trailer for GTA 6 , which shows us brand new footage of Jason and Lucia as well as the open world. The trailer, which weighs in at 1:30, touches on Jason's troubled past, which involved leaving the army not on the best of terms. We see snippets of a steamy shower scene with Lucia, who is wearing an ankle tag, and plenty of explosive open-world action. Rather than showing gameplay, the launch trailer showcases cinematic action in GTA 6 as it nears its November 19 launch. As per Rockstar's partnership with Sony, the PS5 is prominent in the trailer, with the "plays best on PS5" message displayed at the start. The trailer confirms the footage was "captured on PS5." The trailer begins with some narration from Jason. "I got in some trouble in the army," he begins. "Didn't leave on the best of terms. They don't give loans or anything to people like me." We see a bearded Jason working at Brian's Marina, buffing a boat before he receives a call from Lucia Caminos. Presumably this is the call Jason gets to pick up Lucia from prison. We're shown what look like flashbacks to Jason's time in the army, where he appears to have been in the special forces. We see him wading through water as part of a military unit, and leaping out of a helicopter while on some sort of mission. But these scenes could easily be set in the "present," rather than the past, with Jason gearing up for, perhaps, a police operation. Either way, it explains why Jason is so handy with a gun. We're then treated to various shots showing Jason and Lucia getting up to no good across Vice City, with glimpses of that steamy shower scene. The shot of Lucia wearing an ankle tag could hint at initial restrictions to exploration, as more of the world is opened up during progression through the story, but that's speculation. This week, we learnt about GTA 6's sweat system, and there's a shot in the launch trailer that looks to show this in action. We see a man working out, and he's putting a lot of effort in. Sweat? Yep, it's all there. "Are we gonna be okay?" Lucia asks Jason after yet more explosive shots. "We stuck together through everything," Jason replies. "Just gotta get through it." Here's the official blurb from Rockstar on the GTA 6 launch trailer: We also have confirmation that electronic duo Justice composed the original score for GTA 6. Indeed their track, Flower in a Hurricane, featuring fellow Grammy-winners Tame Impala and SZA along with King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, plays during the launch trailer. It's been a busy week for GTA 6. We've got a report on what sounds like the end of Cyberleek , details of GTA 6’s sweat system , and confirmation GTA 6 is eligible for The Game Awards 2026 . sources.title: GTA 6's Official Launch Trailer Teases Wild Sex Scenes
sources.text: The short trailer from Rockstar shows the sights in Leonida, missions, and some steamier moments We are 35 days out from the release of Grand Theft Auto 6 , and Rockstar is drumming up hype for the game with an official launch trailer. The video provides a fresh look at the Florida-inspired state Leonida, as well as Jason and Lucia's story. It also features some, shall we say, heated moments between the two lovers . In the trailer, Jason receives a call from Lucia while in prison. He reveals he was discharged from the Army early for an unspecified reason. We get a look at a variety of heists, some of which can get surprisingly high-tech — Jason is shown wearing some gear that would look right at home in a Call of Duty game. The trailer is only a minute and a half long, but it also packs quick glimpses of intimate moments between Jason and Lucia. The two can be seen sharing a shower, kissing, and pushing each other up against the bathroom wall. It's here that the trailer reveals Lucia is still wearing an ankle monitor. It's not quite as risqué as the leaked footage of naked Lucia and Jason , but it's also not clear if playable portions of the game will actually mirror the leaks. In that unauthorized footage, Jason and Lucia walk around the city completely naked, with jiggle physics and everything, but the NPCs don't seem to remark on it. This has led some to speculate that the leaker was showing off nudity via dev tools. The game includes nudity, and game ratings say that GTA 6 will feature sex scenes . So far, it seems like the scenes are framed so players cannot see the characters' private parts. Rockstar has also revealed the trailer's soundtrack includes the debut of "Flower in a Hurricane," an original song by Justice. The original score features artists such as Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard. Rockstar previously gave players a taste of the open-world game's radio stations. GTA 6 will release on Nov. 19 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X.

sources.title: GTA 6 launch trailer shows a more intimate Jason and Lucia as fans struggle to believe it's real
sources.text: New Grand Theft Auto 6 launch trailer really makes it feel real – we made it The GTA 6 launch trailer is here, formally ushering in the next era of Grand Theft Auto after more than a decade post-GTA 5. Rockstar shared the new trailer earlier today, "featuring the debut of 'Flower in a Hurricane' from original score composers Justice feat. Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard." The short trailer sees the dual protagonists, Jason and Lucia, open up about their struggles. Jason notably sports long hair for much of the trailer; in the opening seconds, he discusses the obstacles he's faced after a less-than-glamorous military departure. Lucia is seen sporting a monitoring anklet during an intimate shower scene, and at one point wonders, "Are we gonna be OK" amid a storm of crime. Rockstar was in a very helicopter mood with this trailer. One helicopter crashes behind an assault rifle-toting Jason, Lucia rides another through the streets with a grenade launcher in hand, and in a third sequence a chopper is shown carrying a chained load of (presumably stolen) cargo through the city like a wrecking ball, shattering a row of windows on another building. A once-again short-haired Jason emerges from a helicopter in the next shot, only to cut to him and Lucia jumping off a roof into some sort of hotel pool. "Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them," reads the video description. "But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive." The early response from Grand Theft Auto fans is unsurprisingly enormous, with millions piling into Rockstar's accounts across social media. The trailer crossed 1 million views on YouTube in about half an hour, if you can trust overwhelmed metrics. In the comments, GTA 6 hopefuls express disbelief at finally having a launch trailer in their hands. "I thought I would never live this moment," reads one top comment. "We are really at the finish line!!!" says another fan. Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more Grand Theft Auto 6 is out November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X. The launch trailer was captured on PS5, with a clear PlayStation marketing push bookending it. As if you needed another reminder of why GTA 6 took so long, it has a realistic sweat system that makes Jason and Lucia perspire based on how hard they dance . Austin has been a game journalist for 12 years, having freelanced for the likes of PC Gamer, Eurogamer, IGN, Sports Illustrated, and more while finishing his journalism degree. He's been with GamesRadar+ since 2019. They've yet to realize his position is a cover for his career-spanning Destiny column, and he's kept the ruse going with a lot of news and the occasional feature, all while playing as many roguelikes as possible. sources.title: Catálogo de jogos PlayStation Plus para outubro: Mafia: The Old Country, Horizon Forbidden West, Mycopunk e muito mais
sources.text: Dino Crisis 2 e RollerCoaster Tycoon 3 Complete Edition chegam no PlayStation Plus Deluxe. Neste mês, mergulhe no submundo do crime da Sicília do início do século XX em Mafia: The Old Country, enfrente uma fronteira mortal repleta de máquinas impressionantes em Horizon Forbidden West ou encare hordas de inimigos fúngicos com um arsenal extravagante de armas futuristas no jogo de ação cooperativa frenética Mycopunk, todos chegam no catálogo de jogos do PlayStation Plus já em outubro. Enquanto isso, o PlayStation Plus Premium recebe Dino Crisis 2 e RollerCoaster Tycoon 3. A lista completa de títulos estará disponível para jogar em 20 de outubro, salvo indicação em contrário. E, com a chegada da temporada de Halloween, os membros da PlayStation Plus podem aproveitar uma seleção de ofertas exclusivas como parte das nossas comemorações do Horrorfest. Confira os detalhes completos abaixo desta publicação. Descubra as origens do crime organizado nesta conturbada história de máfia ambientada no submundo brutal da Sicília do início do século XX. Lute para sobreviver como Enzo Favara e prove seu valor para a família nesta envolvente ação em terceira pessoa, que se passa em um momento histórico perigoso e implacável. Esta fantástica história ganha ainda mais vida com os visuais impressionantes, a narrativa cinematográfica e o realismo autêntico que consagrou a fama da aclamada série Mafia. A história de Enzo se passa em uma época em que a destreza com uma lâmina de estilete era letal, a espingarda lupara de cano cerrado era a arma de fogo preferida, vinganças sangrentas se prolongaram por décadas e os mafiosos patrulhavam seus territórios a pé, a cavalo ou ao volante dos primeiros automóveis. Acompanhe Aloy ao enfrentar o Oeste Proibido em uma fronteira majestosa, mas perigosa, que esconde novas e misteriosas ameaças. Explore terras distantes, enfrente máquinas maiores e mais imponentes e conheça novas tribos extraordinárias neste retorno ao futuro distante e pós-apocalíptico de Horizon. Reencontre velhos amigos, firme alianças com novas facções em conflito e desvende o legado de um passado ancestral — tudo isso enquanto tenta manter-se um passo à frente de um novo inimigo aparentemente invencível. Fatie alienígenas fúngicos neste jogo de tiro com saque baseado em missões e com altíssimo nível de personalização. Centenas de melhorias feitas à mão, modo cooperativo para 4 jogadores e um pequeno homem-barata. Como não amar? Um esquadrão de robôs rejeitados é contratado pela corporação SAXON e recebe uma última chance de conquistar a glória e alguns lucros (e evitar o ferro-velho). É a Equipe de Risco de Novo Atlas, um esquadrão de exterminadores em frangalhos enviado para descobrir os mistérios por trás de uma catástrofe fúngica que afeta todo o planeta. Embarque numa série de missões perigosas no planeta para afastar a ameaça micológica. Será um simples desastre natural como alegam? E será que a SAXON não fez direito a sua declaração de imposto de renda? Ou foi culpa sua? Mycopunk chega ao Catálogo de Jogos PlayStation dia 20 de outubro. Após um confronto com Huggy Wuggy e libertar Poppy, você deve descer mais fundo na fábrica de brinquedos da Playtime Co. Quebra-cabeças desafiadores e brinquedos horripilantes aguardam. Use ganchos, balance-se e abra caminho com força até a segurança. Tente escapar, e não deixe a mamãe encontrar você. Continue explorando as profundezas da Playtime Co. em busca de respostas. Sua jornada para descobrir o que aconteceu dentro da fábrica está apenas começando… Poppy Playtime: Chapter 2 estará disponível em 27 de outubro. Embarque em The Midnight Walk, uma aventura de fantasia sombria e reverente moldada em argila, criada pelas mentes por trás de Lost in Random, Fe e Ghost Giant. Torne-se o The Burnt One, faça amizade com uma criatura-lanterna perdida chamada Potboy e use a chama dele para iluminar seu caminho por um mundo de contrastes, repleto de maravilhas e horrores. Sobreviva e supere com astúcia os muitos monstros ávidos por devorar a chama do seu amiguinho enquanto vivencia cinco contos de fogo e escuridão, com um elenco incrível de personagens peculiares. Encante-se com cada detalhe perturbador de uma paisagem meticulosamente criada à mão com argila real e animada no estilo stop-motion. Totalmente jogável tanto no PS5 quanto em RV – com o PS VR2. The Midnight Walk estará disponível hoje, 14 de outubro. Tales of Arise – Beyond the Dawn Edition | PS5, PS4 Por 300 anos, Rena dominou Dahna, saqueando os recursos de seu planeta e privando as pessoas de sua dignidade e liberdade. Nossa história começa com duas pessoas nascidas em mundos diferentes, cada uma procurando mudar seu destino e criar um novo futuro. Com um elenco diversificado de personagens, um sistema de combate intuitivo e gratificante e uma história cativante ambientada em um exuberante mundo pelo qual vale a pena lutar, Tales of Arise oferece uma experiência de JRPG excelente. Tales of Arise – Beyond the Dawn Edition estará disponível em 27 de outubro. Monster Energy Supercross 25 – The Official Video Game | PS5 Vivencie a emoção de correr em pistas recém-projetadas que replicam eventos do mundo real e dispute com a mais recente lista de pilotos profissionais: abra o caminho em uma carreira renovada com competições intensas, rivalidades e escolhas estratégicas. Graças ao Unreal Engine 5, aproveite um gameplay renovado com física realista e evolução dinâmica da pista, tornando cada volta única e desafiadora. stories.title: Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser says he 'failed' with Max Payne 3, and I'm sorry Danno but that's just plain wrong

sources.name: PC Gamer
sources.title: Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser says he 'failed' with Max Payne 3, and I'm sorry Danno but that's just plain wrong
sources.text: Dan Houser is a co-founder of Rockstar Games and so I would never presume to tell him he's wrong about any of the games Rockstar has made— except in this one particular instance, where I feel obligated to step up and say, 'Dan, I'm sorry bud, but you're wrong.' The game in question is Max Payne 3 , on which Houser played a central role, and one he seems rather down on: In an interview with IGN , he said the game was a "failure" because, simply put, he's not Sam Lake, the Remedy creative director who wrote the first two Max Payne games. As a very linear game, Max Payne 3 "was a little different" from the open world GTA games he was accustomed to, Houser said, but he also really enjoyed the experience. "I loved what we did design-wise, the way the game didn't have loads, the way it felt like a 12-hour movie, some of the visual stuff we did with words on screen. Alas, he continued, "I felt we were creating a really cool digital noir experience, and the consensus at the time was that people hated it. "So I got that completely wrong," Houser said. "I know Sam Lake well, and he's a very good guy and really talented. I thought we'd done a good job of doing another Max Payne game. Some people liked it; lots didn't. So we got it wrong, or I got it wrong. I failed. My bit was not a success. "The game is beautifully made, and it wasn't as successful as it should have been. So I would say a large amount of that failure was on me as one of the people making the decisions and also as the writer, when people really missed his writing." Max Payne 3 is a really interesting case study because it's very much a Max Payne game—grim and gritty, filled with bullet time, body drops, and snappy commentary about how much life sucks—but it's also a full-on Rockstar game, and thus a very different vibe from the previous two entries in the series. Fans who were expecting more of the same—or insisting on it, really—were bound to be disappointed. Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team. But Max Payne 3 itself is nothing short of a brilliant, powerhouse cinematic shooter. It really does feel like "a 12-hour movie," powered by lush cut scenes, a brilliant soundtrack by industrial rock group Health, and great performances across the board, in particular from James McCaffrey in the title role. With all due respect to Remedy, this is where McCaffrey really hit his stride, digging deep to deliver some truly great lines: It is fair to say that Max Payne 3 wasn't a massive commercial success: In 2012, publisher Take-Two Interactive said sales of the game came in " lower than expected ," resulting in a significantly increased net loss for the quarter. But that's hardly the only measure of success, and I think it's notable that Take-Two said the same, at the same time, about Spec Ops: The Line , a game widely heralded, then and now, for its daring, subversive narrative. Max Payne 3 was a slower burn, but I think the passage of time has given us a far better perspective on what Rockstar actually delivered: As former PC Gamer writer Andy Kelly wrote a full decade ago, "Over the years I’ve developed a greater appreciation for the risks Rockstar took in breaking Remedy’s established, and beloved, mould." "It’s a radical departure, but it works," the other Andy wrote in his very correct take on Max Payne 3 . "It’s always interesting to see a familiar character thrust into an unfamiliar situation, and Max is hilariously out of place in Brazil. As if being a white American in a favela didn’t draw enough unwanted attention, he makes his life even more difficult by wearing the loudest Hawaiian shirt imaginable. He was comfortable in New York, but here he’s an outsider, and the game plays up to it brilliantly." And so, Dan, with all due respect, I have to say, 'I'm sorry bud, but you're wrong.' Max Payne 3 may have been divisive in its time, and it may not have been the big hit you were hoping for, but I sure wouldn't call it a failure. I'd say Rockstar, and you, absolutely nailed it. From there he graduated to the glory days of Sierra Online adventures and Microprose sims, ran a local BBS, learned how to build PCs, and developed a longstanding love of RPGs, immersive sims, and shooters. sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: Rockstar co-founder Dan Houser blames himself for Max Payne 3 - "a large amount of that failure was on me"
sources.text: "The consensus at the time was that people hated it." Max Payne 3 is a bit of a strange project. Unlike its two predecessors, the game wasn't developed by original creator Remedy Entertainment, rather it was the product of Grand Theft Auto and Red Dead Redemption studio Rockstar Games . Despite that pedigree, it is seen as something of a failure - or, at least, not quite what fans wanted from the third game in the iconic third-person shooter series. And Dan Houser, co-founder of Rockstar, says it was his fault. In a wide-ranging interview with IGN , Houser, who was also Max Payne 3's lead writer, recalled his experience working on the game and how it differed from other Rockstar projects. "It was a linear game, so it was a little different from writing an open-world game, a little more structured," Houser said. "I really enjoyed that as an experience. I loved what we did design-wise, the way the game didn't have loads, the way it felt like a 12-hour movie, some of the visual stuff we did with words on screen. I felt we were creating a really cool digital noir experience, and the consensus at the time was that people hated it." Houser is being a little harsh here; Max Payne 3 was critically acclaimed at launch . The same stylistic, tonal and visual choices many didn't like are what also set it apart from the two prior games. Indeed, Max Payne 3's mechanics remain among the series' best to this day, with smooth third-person movement and sharp gunplay that make it a joy to play over 14 years later. "I know Sam Lake [creator of Max Payne ] well, and he's a very good guy and really talented. I thought we'd done a good job of doing another Max Payne game," Houser added. "Some people liked it; lots didn't. So we got it wrong, or I got it wrong. I failed. My bit was not a success." Max Payne 3 is seen as a commercial disappointment by publisher Take-Two, who said its "lower than expected sales" were mainly responsible for a loss of $110m (~£82,9m) that financial quarter . Houser acknowledged the lower sales in the interview, saying "it wasn't as successful as it should have been". "So I would say a large amount of that failure was on me as one of the people making the decisions and also as the writer, when people really missed [Sam Lake]'s writing," Houser added. Years after Max Payne 3's release, Remedy and Rockstar would be reunited on a mega-project: a remake of Max Payne 1 and 2, which Remedy said two years ago had entered full production . It is understood the remake is Remedy's next project.

sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: 007 First Light gets Switch 2 release date, with IO Interactive saying time for "optimisation and performance" was needed
sources.text: The Switch 2 version of 007 First Light will be released 18th March, 2027, IO Interactive has announced. The game had originally been expected this summer but IOI announced a delay to an unspecific date in March roughly a month ago. "Since announcing additional development time to ensure the quality of experience players expect, IO Interactive has brought hands-on builds of 007 First Light to both gamescom and Tokyo Game Show, where players and press had their first opportunity to experience Bond's world running on Nintendo's hardware," the company said in a press release statement. "Player response from both events has been positive, reflecting the progress being made across the game as development continues toward launch. The development team will use the coming months to continue refining the game's optimisation and performance on Nintendo Switch 2, ensuring it meets the standard players expect at launch." Evidently, it hasn't been a smooth transition. We've heard similar things from Capcom, for what it's worth, with the Monster Hunter Wilds devs claiming it was a "painstaking, seemingly endless process" to get the game running well on Switch 2. The date announcement coincides with pre-orders of a Deluxe Edition going live, which offers access to some extra clothes and gadgets in game. We're also only a couple of weeks on from 007 First Light getting a bumper blob of add-on content , in the form of New Game Plus, a new, harder difficulty, a photo mode, more replayable TacSim challenge missions, and a bit of general game tuning. Presumably all of this will be included in the Switch 2 version when it launches. As it stands, 007 First Light has been one of the stand-out successes of 2026, bringing James Bond back to gaming with flair and aplomb. The Hitman studio delivered a tight, exciting, cinematic single-player adventure filled with charm and wit - not unlike James Bond himself. Eurogamer's gleaming 007 First Light review can tell you more. The game also appears to have been a commercial success, having passed 4 million sales since release - and with a Switch 2 version to come, there's more selling to do. I imagine it makes the likelihood of a sequel very strong, though newish Bond franchise owner Amazon has said it wants to be involved in whatever comes next , whereas IOI was the master of its own destiny with 007 First Light. Meanwhile, IOI is also making a fantasy game called, well, Project Fantasy. This was announced as an online RPG in 2023 , but faced a major setback recently when publisher Xbox pulled out of the project , forcing IOI to close one of its studios and make layoffs across the company - even in the aftermath of 007 First LIght's success. IOI has since regained full ownership of the game and has vowed to continue to develop Project Fantasy independently . The studio also continues to develop and expand Hitman World of Assassination, which recently added rapper Snoop Dogg as an elusive target .

sources.title: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave DLC Officially Fixes Its Most Controversial Change
sources.text: It’s a great time to be a Fire Emblem fan. Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave was released in September 2026 to commercial and critical acclaim. The game brings back the classic elements that made the series popular while introducing some interesting innovations, too. And there's more to come. In a sneaky shadow drop earlier this week, Nintendo and Intelligent Systems revealed that Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave will receive multiple DLCs. The expansion pass, available now, will offer a wealth of content, including new weapons, allies, outfits, and the most promising news of all: additional routes. The first wave adds four new weapons, available through the Fortune’s Weave expansion pass on the Nintendo eShop. Though the game calls them Prototypes, these relics are based on the Heroes’ Relics from Fire Emblem: Three Houses . Below, we’ve listed the four weapons available to players and who they originally belonged to in Three Houses . The second wave of content adds outfits and new allies to the player’s roster and is expected to arrive during the 2026 holiday season. Flame Lords Cai, Dietrich, Theodora, and Leda will all receive additional outfits, which players can swap back to their originals at any time. Better yet, those outfits can be worn by their allies so, if you really want to, your entire roster units can rock the colors of your favorite in-game faction. Players will also have the opportunity to play as the Dagdan gods Aurora, Smyrnos, and Jurah in Part 3 — where these godly entities join the Promised One’s army. While their power isn’t absolute and they can perish, they bring overwhelming gameplay strength you won’t want to pass up. The most exciting news, though, is the third wave of content, which will add four new stories to Fortune’s Weave . These stories will focus on the four other rival lords featured in the game: Anatolia, Talimun, Orchel, and Bertrand. Fire Emblem fans learned from an Intelligent Systems AMA that Fortune’s Weave originally featured eight protagonists, but the team considered that too ambitious and cut it to four, adding avatar character Eshmel to help tie the routes together. However, Intelligent Systems seems to have changed its mind: Wave 3 will feature chapters about these cut lords and their stories. Since many players are working through four routes in an already lengthy game, taking on four more sounds like a monumental task. Still, fans have been calling for the cut routes to return ever since Fortune’s Weave debuted in September. Fan demand may have influenced Intelligent Systems’ decision to restore these four routes to the main game, but the routes were likely already in development, and the team just needed more time to finish them — hence the lack of a release date for this third wave beyond 2027. Regardless, more Fortune’s Weave is on the way, and as everyone else who has been playing non-stop since September, we can’t pretend we're not excited about that.

sources.text: Nintendo and Intelligent Systems have released an expansion pass for Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave, introducing a string of DLC additions to the tactical RPG starting today, and through into 2027. The expansion pass, which can be bought on the Nintendo eShop for $34.99 / £29.99, comes in three parts. For those who buy it now, a selection of weapons are made available to use within the game. The second part of the expansion pass arrives this holiday season, and the final part arrives in 2027. We already know a bit about what's coming in these latter DLC releases. The second portion features additional outfits for the game's cast, alongside three new allies: Aurora, Smyrnos, and Jurah. The final segment of the pass looks to be the most substantial; introducing new stories to play, new allies, classes, and additional goodies. Those new stories make an already chunky game even larger, something that should give people a reason to go back to the RPG next year, and those yet to pick up the game, a convenient jumping-on point. Fortune's Weave has been met with critical acclaim and sizable early sales figures . In Eurogamer's review , the game is described as "a synergy of everything that has made the series great for generations", and "a sumptuous feast of a game".

sources.name: IGN
sources.title: Big Walk Developer Explains Why the Game Isn't on Xbox
sources.text: Big Walk developer House House has explained why it’s boycotting Xbox and thus why the game isn’t available on Microsoft's console. House House, the Australian studio behind Untitled Goose Game, released clever co-op puzzle adventure Big Walk earlier this year on PC, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch 2, leaving Xbox Series X and S out in the cold. Big Walk was critically acclaimed upon release, earning a 91 rating on Metacritic and multiple appearances on Game of the Year contender lists. IGN’s Big Walk review returned a 9/10. We said: “Big Walk is a rewarding co-op adventure full of beautiful emergent moments as you find solutions to cleverly built puzzles and explore its vast open world with your friends.” Since then, fans had wondered why the game failed to come out Xbox. In a statement published to its website , House House said it made the decision as part of its support for campaign group Boycott, Divestment, Sanctions (BDS), which describes itself as a “Palestinian-led movement for freedom, justice and equality.” BDS lists Xbox as a “priority” target, and has launched a campaign calling on gamers, streamers, and developers to boycott Microsoft’s gaming efforts. As reported by the BBC , Microsoft's work with the Israeli government has been a controversial issue, including within the company itself, prompting protests by some employees. House House indicated that it won't release Big Walk on Xbox "until Microsoft and/or Xbox have been removed as BDS boycott targets." sources.text: "Meaningful change can be made in the world". Big Walk developer House House has explained the lack of an Xbox version for the popular co-operative puzzle game, pointing to the ongoing BDS boycott as the core reason behind its decision. In a post made to House House social media accounts , the team writes: "It has always been our intention for Big Walk to be played by groups of friends, and we know that keeping the game off Xbox runs counter to those intentions. This decision means that some people will miss out on playing Big Walk with their friends, and we understand the disappointment we’re causing. We are disappointed too. "We would love for people to be able to play the game on Xbox, but not until Microsoft and/or Xbox have been removed as BDS boycott targets. "We’ve made this decision with the belief that meaningful change can be made in the world, that coordinated collective action can confront even the most powerful interests, and that one day, Palestine will be free." The Palestinian-led BDS movement has been a staunch proponent of various boycotts aimed at companies who have supported Israel's government during the genocide in Palistine. It has published a list of boycott targets, which includes Disney, Intel, and Xbox. Xbox's inclusion on the list is due to Microsoft's partnership with Israel and its prison system according to BDS. The company has provided the country use of its Azure Cloud and AI systems, which have been used consistently over the past few years in the ongoing subjugation of Palestinians. BDS has urged people to cancel their Game Pass subscriptions, boycott major franchises including Call of Duty and Candy Crush , and cease purchases of Microsoft gaming products. Big Walk, despite its lack of an Xbox version, has proven quite popular. A game of great merit , the game sold over one million copies in under a week following its release on the 4th August.

This decision means that some people will miss out on playing Big Walk with their friends, and we understand the disappointment weâre causing. We are disappointed too. We would love for people to be able to play the game on Xbox, but not until Microsoft and/or Xbox have been removed as BDS boycott targets. Weâve made this decision with the belief that meaningful change can be made in the world, that coordinated collective action can confront even the most powerful interests, and that one day, Palestine will be free. The BDS movement has had a few wins in its Microsoft boycott, such as last year when the company disabled the Israeli governmentâs use of its cloud storage and AI systems believed to be used in surveying Palestinians, and back in May when it was reported the company was severing ties with employees in Israel , though the boycott is still ongoing, and has the support of sides of the video game industry that have rallied under the banner of No Games for Genocide . stories.title: GTA 6 Will Make The Game Awards Cutoff Date for Eligibility by the Skin of Its Teeth, Confirming It Has a Chance at 2026 Game of the Year
stories.summary: GTA 6 is officially in with a chance of winning the 2026 Game of the Year award at this year’s The Game Awards, after the show confirmed the cutoff date for eligibility.

sources.name: IGN
sources.title: GTA 6 Will Make The Game Awards Cutoff Date for Eligibility by the Skin of Its Teeth, Confirming It Has a Chance at 2026 Game of the Year
sources.text: GTA 6 is officially in with a chance of winning the 2026 Game of the Year award at this year’s The Game Awards, after the show confirmed the cutoff date for eligibility. According to a FAQ on The Game Awards website , to be in with a chance of winning an award a game must be released on or before Friday, November 20, 2026. GTA 6’s release date is currently November 19, 2026, which means it’s made the cutoff date by just a single day. Nominations for this year’s awards haven’t been announced yet, of course, but it’s hard to imagine a situation where GTA 6 doesn’t show up for most, if not all, the categories it’s eligible for. Sandfall Interactive's Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 holds the world record for the most wins at The Game Awards , taking home a whopping nine awards at last year's show. Will GTA 6 beat it? And given GTA Online 2 or whatever the multiplayer mode ends up being called is reportedly due out next year, perhaps alongside a PC version , we could see GTA 6 back in contention at The Game Awards 2027. While we wait for this year's nominations, we’ve got plenty more on GTA 6 for you to check out, including our in-depth interview with Rockstar North's Rob Nelson , our report on what sounds like the end of Cyberleek , and confirmation of GTA 6’s sweat system . sources.title: GTA 6 is Officially Eligible for The Game Awards 2026
sources.text: The Game Awards 2026 has pretty much hinged on the ‘will it, won’t it’ nature of Grand Theft Auto 6. Rockstar Games’ mega-hyped GTA 6 could potentially sweep most awards it’s up for, and now it’s confirmed the game has just made the cut-off. Outside of the bloat and pomp of The Game Awards , it’s become gaming’s biggest awards night. Viewership and profitability seem to increase year-on-year, and you can expect this to get wilder with news that Rockstar Games and GTA 6 are eligible for the show. Check out The Game Awards 2026’s ‘Cutoff Date for Eligibility’ information: ‘Games must be made commercially available to customers on or before Friday, November 20, 2026, at 9 p.m. PT. In the Players’ Voice category, games must ship on or before November 30, 2026.’ As most of the world knows at this point, Grand Theft Auto 6 finally launches on November 19. It won’t be delayed again, especially not this late, and not even the exhausting list of GTA 6 leaks can derail the game at this point. Based on last year’s categories, GTA 6 could potentially be up for the following awards: New categories could be added, and there might even be other niches the game can slide into; who knows. Unless GTA 6 somehow ends up being a catastrophic failure, it would be a shock if the game doesn’t scoop up a handful of awards. We’ve been spoiled in 2026, one of the better years for gaming, but GTA 6’s inclusion could be a hammer blow to the chances of other titles: Resident Evil Requiem, Control Resonant, Big Walk, Forza Horizon 6, Mina the Hollower, Pokémon Pokopia, and so many others. Will GTA 6 beat Clair Obscur: Expedition 33’s TGA record? Let us know your thoughts on the Insider Gaming Discord server . stories.title: Estúdio brasileiro comemora lançamento de Deep Dish Dungeon no Game Pass: “É um privilégio para nós”
stories.summary: The post Estúdio brasileiro comemora lançamento de Deep Dish Dungeon no Game Pass: “É um privilégio para nós” appeared first on Xbox Wire em Português .

sources.name: Xbox Wire BR
sources.title: Estúdio brasileiro comemora lançamento de Deep Dish Dungeon no Game Pass: “É um privilégio para nós”
sources.text: Saulo Camarotti estava explorando uma masmorra no famoso jogo de sobrevivência Valheim quando teve uma ideia: “Essa dungeon sozinha poderia ser um jogo muito legal”, ele relembra em uma conversa com o XBOX Wire. Dois anos depois, esse jogo se tornou real e está sendo lançado como Deep Dish Dungeons no XBOX Series X|S hoje, 13 de outubro, e disponível desde o primeiro dia para assinantes de XBOX Game Pass Ultimate. Em antecipação à chegada de mais um jogo brasileiro ao Game Pass, conversamos com Saulo para explorarmos juntos essa masmorra de Deep Dish Dungeon , talvez até encontrar alguns segredos…. Gênero : Dungeon Crawler/Survivor/Metroidvania Desenvolvedora : Behold Studios Publicadora : Raw Fury Plataformas : Steam, XBOX Series X|S, XBOX no PC e Portátil Modos : solo ou multiplayer até 3 jogadores online Funcionalidades : XBOX Play Anywhere e Cross-Play (Steam e consoles XBOX) Idioma : português Brasileiro nas legendas e interface Em Deep Dish Dungeon controlamos um explorador em busca de tesouros em uma masmorra, sozinho ou na companhia de amigos. E é isso. Uma premissa simples e sem muitos rodeios, já que a ideia, segundo Saulo, nunca foi guiar o jogador para onde ele deve ir. “Eu queria criar uma experiência sobre explorar uma masmorra como um aventureiro e não como um guerreiro”, explica o desenvolvedor. “Não é sobre matar, morrer e ganhar nível. Esse é um jogo em que você tenta entender esse lugar antigo em ruinas e tenta sobreviver”. Com esse foco em exploração, Saulo diz que Deep Dish Dungeon tem uma média de 15 horas de duração até ser finalizado. Enquanto o jogador descobre mais sobre o tesouro que está buscando, e o próprio lugar em si por meio de narrativas espalhadas pelo cenário, surge uma das mecânicas de jogos mais importantes: cozinhar. Já dizia o ditado: saco vazio não para em pé… nem explora, por isso que é fundamental preparar comidas que dão vantagens ao jogador – daí o “Dish” (prato de comida em tradução livre) no nome. “Você come antes de se aventurar. Não é depois, para se curar”, explica Saulo. “E cada categoria de ingrediente no jogo dá uma vantagem diferente, como mais vida ou vigor”. Foi nesse aspecto da culinária que a Behold colocou um tempero de brasilidade ao jogo, com ingredientes como semente de guaraná e mandioca (ou macaxeira ou aipim dependendo da região do país) ou quitutes como coxinha , pastel e bolo de fubá que podem ser preparados. Dá até água na boca. Alguns exemplos de efeito de ingredientes: A própria presença desses ingredientes típicos do Brasil também dá dicas da localização dessa masmorra, apesar do jogo nunca revelar de fato onde é. “O jogo acontece num lugar fictício, mas para nós, internamente, está mais ou menos ali na Amazônia”, revela Saulo. A partir desse conceito, o time se baseou nas criações de elementos de arte e arquitetura que compõe o lugar. Outra caraterística importante em Deep Dish Dungeons é que masmorra que o jogador explora é fixa e não criada proceduralmente. Saulo diz que isso foi uma decisão proposital. Para que cada lugar, obstáculo e segredo foi pensado para dar um senso de progressão que é mais próximo dos jogos no estilo “Metroidvania” do que os de Survival. “A masmorra é toda interconectada que nem um Metroidvania, e à medida que você encontra ferramentas e ganha habilidades, você consegue abrir novas salas e explorar mais a fundo”, explica o desenvolvedor. Essas ferramentas podem ser achadas pelo cenário ou criadas com recurso coletados durante a exploração. Ao obter um martelo , por exemplo, é possível quebrar portas de ferro que antes bloqueavam uma nova área. Já criar um gancho abre possibilidades de agora ir a lugares elevados que podem ter passagens secretas ou dar acesso a novos ambientes. Deep Dish Dungeon é o primeiro título da Behold Studios a chegar no XBOX Game Pass. No Brasil, o estúdio ganhou notoriedade na década passada ao lançar sucessos indies como Knights of Pen & Papper e Chroma Squad , mas Saulo diz que o novo jogo representa uma nova fase para eles, de projetos com produções rápidas e de escopo simples, mas eficaz. O novo game foi desenvolvido em apenas dois anos e por uma equipe de duas pessoas: Saulo na direção, programação e Game Design, e Carolina Baumgarten na arte. Por isso, a visibilidade dada pelo Game Pass foi o estímulo muito bem-vindo para o estúdio nesse momento, como a refeição que dá benefícios antes da exploração da masmorra, ou nessa, caso, do lançamento do jogo. Saulo também explica que estar no Game Pass impulsiona um dos aspectos mais importantes de Deep Dish Dungeon : o multiplayer. Apesar de poder ser jogado sozinho, o jogo foi pensado, desde o início, para ser uma experiência compartilhada junto com outras pessoas em cooperação. “Criar uma comunidade multiplayer nesse tipo de jogo é essencial”, diz Saulo. ““O nosso jogo é multiplayer e cross-play. Então, se você está jogando no Game Pass, pode chamar um amigo que tá no Steam”. Então, reúna seus amigos exploradores, estejam eles no console ou no PC, prepare os suplementos, cozinhe um bolo de fubá e saia para descobrir os segredos e tesouros de Deep Dish Dungeon , que já está disponível exclusivamente nos consoles para XBOX Series X|S, XBOX no PC e no XBOX Game Pass Ultimate.
